notes: Thorough investigation found NO genuine Bestsellers/Top-Sellers merchandising PLP on castorama.fr. Checked: (1) main header/footer nav and homepage flight-data JSON - the only 'meilleures ventes' occurrence is the string 'Nos meilleures ventes' used as the title of a PDP-only 'you may also like' recommendation carousel (app.pdp.category-product-recommendations.title), not a standalone listing page with its own URL. (2) The homepage also has a 'Les incontournables du moment' (must-haves of the moment) block, which is a Certona-powered personalized recommendation widget embedded on the homepage itself, not a dedicated PLP. (3) Every category/listing PLP on the site (verified on both the Destockage and Nos nouveautes hubs fetched for the sibling projects) exposes 'Trier par: ... Meilleures ventes ...' as a SORT option alongside Pertinence/Prix/Notes/Nouveautes - this re-sorts whatever category is currently open by internal sales rank; it does not create a distinct, site-scoped Bestsellers listing with its own product set/count, so per brief section 3 this is an arbitrary sort/filter, not a qualifying PLP. (4) Searched the full category sitemap (sitemap-cat.xml, 4841 URLs) for vente/best/populair/tendance/favori/classement/top- patterns: the only 'vente' hit was '/nos-collections/nos-collections-salle-de-bains/les-accessoires-de-salle-de-bains-et-wc-koros/la-meilleure-vente-koros/cat_id_0005592.cat' ('the best seller of the Koros [bathroom accessory] line') - opened and confirmed it is (a) currently a zero-product listing (site's own message: 'Desole, nous n'avons aucun "La meilleure vente Koros" disponible pour le moment') and (b) even when populated this names the single top-selling SKU within one narrow branded sub-collection, not a sitewide or department-wide Bestsellers merchandising concept - excluded on both grounds (zero products, and not a genuine Bestsellers taxonomy node). (5) Checked the 'Bonnes affaires' (deals) hub and its 11 children (offre-du-moment, offres-de-remboursement, foire-a-la-droguerie, les-journees-du-bricolage, selection-* curated pages, idees-cadeaux, casto-pro-les-consommables) - all promotional/curated pages, none framed as popularity/bestseller merchandising. (6) Checked sitemap-autre.xml (253 URLs) - no bestseller-pattern hits (only unrelated 'tendance' editorial/inspiration articles). Site search was not used as primary evidence per brief (and /search?* is SEO-blocked in robots.txt); navigation and sitemap coverage above is considered sufficient proof of absence. Conclusion: this is a correct, valuable 'no genuine Bestsellers PLP exists' finding, not a failure to find one.
